segments.text: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

footnotes.text: + ye mighty: Heb. ye sons of the mighty

segments.text: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

footnotes.text: + the glory…: Heb. the honour of his name
+ in…: or, in his glorious sanctuary

segments.text: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests:

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

footnotes.text: + to calve: or, to be in pain
+ doth…: or, every whit of it uttereth, etc

segments.text: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
